song.title: In Christ Alone
song.lyrics:
[V1] . D Bm A In Christ alone my hope is found. .D/F# G A D He is my light, my strength, my song. . Dsus D Bm A This Cornerstone, this solid Ground, .D/F# G A D Firm through the fiercest drought and storm. . D/F# G Bm A What heights of love, what depths of peace! . D/F# G Bm7 Asus When fears are stilled, when strivings cease! . G D Bm A My Comforter, my All in All: . D/F# G A D Here in the love of Christ I stand.
[V2] . D Bm A In Christ alone! who took on flesh, .D/F# G A D Fullness of God in helpless babe! . Dsus D Bm A This Gift of love and righteousness, .D/F# G A D Scorned by the ones He came to save. . D/F# G Bm Asus Till on that cross as Jesus died, . D/F# G Bm7 Asus The wrath of God was satisfied. . G D Bm A For every sin on Him was laid: .D/F# G A D Here in the death of Christ I live.
[V3] . D Bm A There in the ground His body lay, .D/F# G A D Light of the world by darkness slain. . D Bm A Then bursting forth in glorious Day, .D/F# G A D Up from the the grave He rose again! . D/F# G Bm Asus And as He stands in victory, . D/F# G Bm7 Asus Sin's curse has lost it's grip on me! . G D Bm A For I am His and He in mine, .D/F# G A D Bought with the precious blood of Christ.
[V4] . D Bm A No guilt in life, no fear in death, .D/F# G A D This is the power of Christ in me! . Em D Bm A From life's first cry to final breath, .D/F# G A D Jesus commands my destiny! . D/F# G Bm Asus No power of hell, no scheme of man, . D/F# G Bm7 Asus Can ever pluck me from His hand! . G D Bm A Till He returns or calls me home: .D/F# G A D Here in the power of Christ I'll stand!
song.author: Stuart Townend, Keith Getty, Stuart Townend, Keith Getty, Newsboys
